1.3.0
- Mining: every ore deposit in the world, 21 kinds, on the world map, the minimap and in Find, each with its own row in the Map Key.
- Materials, Plants and Bait: farm soil, twigs, tar, ice, 30 plants, fireflies, frogs and more, the same way.
- Trees: every forest drawn as a shape in its tree type's colour, with the big ones named.
- Two more zoom steps out on the world map. Requested by HadToRegister.
- The Map Key scrolls (mouse wheel or scroll bar), SHOW ALL / HIDE ALL are back at its top, and the category bars look like the game's own.
- Looted chests are shared: players who have the mod see the chests the others open.
- Reported bugs fixed: some quests and lore rumors hid under other icons (Deadcow67, KazarusKain); Show on Map (F) in the Journal opened the map on the player (sandesign, Loling91, KazarusKain); with a gamepad, the map cursor didn't move after tabbing to the map (Chocobostew).
